caption_used: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive Reasoning. The Categorical pie chart comprises four segments: Universal Quantifiers (29.07%), Negation (27.91%), Limiter (27.91%), and Existential Quantifiers (15.12%). In the Approximate Number Generation chart, Comparative Relationships constitute the largest share at approximately 48%, followed by Approximate Quantities at 33.26% and Absolute Absence at 18.71%. The Disjunctive & Conjunctive chart shows a near-even split, with Conjunctive slightly dominating at 54.51% over Disjunctive at 45.49%.

The Approximate Number Generation pie chart has three slices with internal labels and percentages: Approximate Quantities (pale cream) at 45.03%, Comparative Relationships (light blue) at 36.26%, and Absolute Absence (light lavender) at 18.71%, with the 45.03% wedge visually largest and 18.71% smallest. The Disjunctive & Conjunctive pie chart has two slices with internal labels and percentages: Disjunctive (very light blue-gray) at 49.51% and Conjunctive (light mauve) at 50.49%, forming an almost even split. None of the charts show axes or a separate legend, and no slices are exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond the centered text labels.
